title: DentAI Quality Ledger Entry
description: Evidence-driven defect/observation record for the DentAI engineering control plane. Written only by agents operating under docs/agents/ contracts.

id.description: Ledger identifier. Format: QLE-YYYY-NNNN, assigned monotonically by the bootstrap/triage agent.

engineeringSeverity.description: P0 = blocks release or breaks a core flow; P1 = major defect; P2 = moderate; P3 = minor/cosmetic.

clinicalRisk.description: Assessed against docs/testing/SAFETY_INVARIANTS.md. When UNKNOWN, entry is automatically HUMAN_REVIEW until a CLINICAL_VERIFIER assesses it.

status.description: Lifecycle state. See docs/continuous/TRIAGE_POLICY.md for allowed transitions.

surface.description: Where detected: 'client' | 'server' | 'shared-lib' | 'api' | 'infra' | 'docs'. See docs/testing/STATE_INVENTORY.md for the surface model.

screen.description: If UI: the screen id from docs/testing/SCREEN_INVENTORY.md (e.g. 'chairside-workspace').

API.description: If server: the endpoint id from docs/testing/API_INVENTORY.md (e.g. 'POST /api/consultations/:id/sign').

journey.description: If cross-cutting: the journey id from docs/testing/GOLDEN_JOURNEYS.md.

reproduction.description: Deterministic reproduction steps or the command/fixture that reproduces.

evidence.description: Paths under reports/ (test runs, logs, transcripts, screenshots). Never inline clinical or PHI content.

regressionTest.description: Test file / test name added or required to prevent recurrence.

releaseRisk.description: Free-text assessment: what happens if shipped unreleased/unfixed.

owner.description: Agent role (docs/agents/) or human handle responsible for the next action.
